name: P10
title: Multimodal Preoperative Optimization Pathway
description: The patient completes anamnesis, followed by blood sample collection, ECG recording, and chest X-ray examination. The patient then undergoes an anaesthesia consultation and receives preoperative education regarding the surgical procedure.
